thread:
jordan: heads up — console is showing v2 rollout at 60% but routing logs show lots of v1 traffic still. thinking telemetry staleness + cached rollouts is deceiving the UX. anyone else seeing this?

sarah: saw that this morning. dashboard tiles are aggregating on a 5m window and our route-probe pings are sampled, so quick flipovers don't show. :eyes: 

pm-ian: is the mismatch safe or just confusing? do customers actually get routed to v1 while console says v2?

jordan: safe (requests served), but confusing — users see the green "v2 active" badge and assume full cutover. some teams started toggling quotas based on that.

leo: quick data point: probing the routing service I can still see header `x-client-version: 1` being routed to v1 variants. console UI reads from metrics-ingest which has a 2m ingest delay + 3m aggregation window.

maria: that's rough. can we show an explicit freshness indicator on the rollout card? like "data delayed ~3m" or a live toggle.

sarah: +1 to freshness indicator. also we should special-case the routing badge when we detect conflicting sources (config state says v2, but active-route-samples show >10% v1).

jordan: proposal: add a small amber warning on rollout banner when (config != observed) AND observed sample >= 5% for >1m. also decrease UI aggregation window for rollout tiles to 1m for high-visibility flags.

leo: implementation notes: telemetry pipeline currently drops route samples older than 10s in the front tier, then aggregates in pipeline with a default `window=300s`. Changing to 60s window is doable but increases cost.

pm-ian: tradeoffs OK if we limit it to rollout dashboard only. Ops can pay for more ingestion for that specific stream. can we do adaptive sampling? e.g., bump probe sample to 100% during canary window for first 5m then back to 1%.
thread_continued:
maria: adaptive sampling is good. also add a cheap heuristic: if `x-route-override` headers are present we consider those admin actions and raise the observed-confidence.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: rollout-state-updater v0.9 -> v1.0 at 2025-02-10T15:00Z (canary).

jordan: thanks ops-bot. next: telemetry stale alerts — ops should get flagged when routing-observed diverges >5% for >3m. we need an alert and a console toast that explains the discrepancy and links to request-level trace probe.

sarah: adding to that: surface last-probe-time on the tile and a little `Refresh now` button that triggers an on-demand probe and temporarily increases sampling for 30s. keep the default long-aggregation to control cost.

leo: sample config sketch:
```json
{
  "probe": { "base_sample": 0.01, "canary_boost": 1.0, "boost_duration_s": 300, "on_demand_boost_ms": 30000 }
}
```

maria: perfect. UX copy: "Observed routing data is delayed up to 3m — click Refresh to run a live probe (temporary higher sampling)." simple and honest.

pm-ian: also document behavior for deprecations: when we mark v1 deprecated, console should show two things: a deprecation timeline and a real-time "migration health" metric that uses same probe stream so customers can see migration progress without being misled by cached aggregates.

jordan: action items: 1) leo: prototype 1m aggregation on rollout tile + on-demand probe button (PR + perf estimate) 2) sarah: add banner UX copy + amber warning rules 3) maria: update docs + deprecation timeline language 4) pm-ian: add alerting thresholds to runbook. please post PR links here.

leo: I'll open a short-lived branch — will include perf delta numbers. aiming for demo by EOD tomorrow.

sarah: i'll mock the banner copy and badging states in Figma, will drop link.

pm-ian: thanks team. one more ask: can we include trace-pct (percent of routed requests traced) in the rollout card so we can know how representative observed samples are?  

maria: yes — show `trace coverage: 0.8% (est. error ±0.5%)` so teams understand uncertainty.

jordan: good. if no blockers, let's treat this as non-blocking UX improvement for ongoing deprecations. we should land the probe button first.

ops-bot: reminder: change window for rollout-aggregator requires schema bump `rollout_tiles.v2` — migration window 02/12 -> 02/19.

leo: ack, will include migration note in PR.

jordan: great work. cc @all — avoid flipping quotas purely on console badge until we have live-probe confidence. :+1:
